## [1.1.0](https://github.com/Nezumi-2711/morphe-patches/compare/v1.0.1...v1.1.0) (2026-10-20)

### 🐛 Bug Fixes

* avoid Zalo chat info crash on non-option rows ([59b6f9a](https://github.com/Nezumi-2711/morphe-patches/commit/59b6f9a9964b203dc13a580487efbb7ccfb763d0))

### ✨ New Features

* **zalo:** combine Drive media backup with microG support ([2db444b](https://github.com/Nezumi-2711/morphe-patches/commit/2db444bb74456b6664203bff0f90613e0500488a))

patches.name: Chat heads instead of Android bubbles
patches.description: Use Zalo's overlay chat heads rather than native Android bubbles on Android 11 and newer.

patches.name: Chat reaction picker
patches.description: Allow the enabled chat reaction UI without a matching subscription package.

patches.name: Drive backup via microG
patches.description: Enable Google Drive photo backup and use microG for Drive accounts and authentication.

patches.name: Hide delivery receipts
patches.description: Suppress outgoing message delivery ACKs when enabled in Nezumi Settings.

patches.name: Hide read receipts
patches.description: Keep outgoing read receipts private while retaining delivery ACKs when enabled in Nezumi Settings.

patches.name: Hide text typing
patches.description: Hide outgoing text typing in direct and group chats when enabled in Nezumi Settings.

patches.name: Native signature fix
patches.description: Allow Zalo 26.08.01 ARM64 to start after patching and re-signing.
